title: Recover the refrigerant before opening the A/C system
when: before the compressor, condenser or lines are disturbed

title: Keep a stored lithium battery above its BMS cutoff
when: monthly while the Ionic S9 waits unfitted

title: Jack the car and set it on safety stands
when: before any work under the car
tools: floor jack, safety stands, wheel chocks

title: Tow the car
when: whenever the car is moved by a tow truck or a rope
tools: tow truck with a wheel lift, or wheel dollies
